function.name: read
function.description: Read the contents of a text file (relative or absolute path). Output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files and continue with offset when truncated.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read
